name: Rakib Hossan
availability: 🎓 Graduating Jan 2027 · actively seeking PhD admission (Fall 2027) in NLP & LLMs. Professors with openings — please reach out, I'd love to talk.
lead: I work on large language models and natural language processing — how to make AI systems reason better, stay grounded in evidence, and work reliably across languages, speech, and real-world data.
bio: I'm currently an AI Engineer at Penta Global Ltd., building LLM systems end to end — from retrieval and generation to evaluation and reliability. I'm also finishing my B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering at BUBT (CGPA 4.00). Before computer science, I spent several years at sea as a marine engineer on VLCC super tankers — which taught me to care a lot about systems that must not fail.

news.html: Moved into an AI Engineer role at Penta Global Ltd., building LLM pipelines for scientific claim extraction and evidence grounding.
Completed three DeepLearning.AI specializations: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and NLP.
First-author paper PromptGuard presented at the BLP Workshop, AACL-IJCNLP 2025. Paper →

points: Design LLM pipelines for claim extraction, evidence grounding, and dependency-graph validation over scientific documents.
Apply RAG, majority-vote consensus across repeated generations, and LLM-judge quality scoring to reduce hallucination.
Debug and validate each stage against real documents, tracking failure modes to keep design decisions evidence-based.
Built a multi-stage LLM pipeline to extract, structure, and translate a large-scale human-rights dataset from a scanned Bangla source.
Cross-referenced extracted records against an independent third-party dataset to validate accuracy.
Enterprise applications: Bangladesh Election Commission web system, ISP billing services, and the HRM Management System.
Institution management, Keycloak auth, MinIO file storage, Liquibase migrations, Dockerized deployment. Contributors →

background.html: Before moving into computer science, I worked at sea maintaining main engines (incl. Mitsubishi 7UEC85LS), generators, boilers, purifiers, and emergency machinery — safety-critical, team-coordinated work that shapes how I think about building reliable AI systems.

publications.title: PromptGuard at BLP-2025 Task 1: A Few-Shot Classification Framework Using Majority Voting and Keyword Similarity for Bengali Hate Speech Detection
publications.venue: Proceedings of the BLP Workshop @ AACL-IJCNLP 2025
publications.abstract: A prompt-based, few-shot framework for Bengali hate speech detection that combines LLM classification with majority voting across repeated generations and keyword-similarity signals, targeting reliable predictions in a low-resource language setting.

projects.title: Evidence Claim Pipeline (Thesis)
projects.text: A system that extracts claims from scientific papers and reasons about the evidence and premises behind them, using claim verification and abductive reasoning with LLMs.
projects.collab: Shubhashis Roy Dipta, Mir Sazzat Hossain, MD Fahim

projects.title: Bangla Dialectal Medical ASR Benchmark
projects.text: A benchmark for clinically significant errors in Bangla dialectal medical speech recognition, built from synthetic doctor–patient conversations generated with LLMs and text-to-speech.
projects.collab: MD Fahim, Mir Sazzat Hossain, Intesar Tahmid, Galib Mahmud Jim, Md Mahir Jawad

projects.title: Human-Rights Dataset Extraction
projects.text: Multi-stage LLM pipeline that turns a scanned Bangla source document into a structured, translated dataset, validated against an independent third-party dataset.

_repoDescriptions: Which repos show (and their order) comes from your pinned repos on GitHub. These only fill in descriptions for repos that have none on GitHub.

repoDescriptions.PromptGuard: Code for our AACL-IJCNLP 2025 paper: few-shot LLM classification with majority voting and keyword similarity for Bengali hate speech detection.
repoDescriptions.abductive_reasoning: Natural language inference experiments with Qwen3-8B, exploring how LLMs reason about premises and hypotheses.
repoDescriptions.ml-penta: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and RoBERTa fine-tuning experiments.
repoDescriptions.transformers_architechture_3D_view: Interactive 3D visualization of how a Transformer processes a sentence, stage by stage. React + Three.js.
repoDescriptions.securegate-ai-pentest: Secure auth portal with a multi-agent security validation suite: five agents (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, lockout, headers) test whether each defense holds.
repoDescriptions.fastapi-react-ml-platform: Full-stack ML inference platform: submit text or images, track jobs in real time over WebSockets. FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Hugging Face, React.
